definition: A versioned application profile mapping standard chess into typed state, verified moves, deterministic transitions, proof search and exact bounded tablebases.
Separate exact rule/proof results, heuristic search results, external standards and unproved full-game claims.
q carries the serialized FEN position, exact repetition-count context, rule profile and lineage; proof identity projects away non-semantic fullmove notation.
Map a1..h8 bijectively to integer cells 0..63 with explicit file/rank transforms.
Piece type, color and square are distinct fields; captured pieces leave the board through a verified event.
One bit selects the mover only; it never replaces board, rights, clocks or lineage.
Four explicit rights are carried and patched by king/rook moves or home-rook capture.
A transient target square is typed separately and admitted only under pawn and king-safety guards.
Halfmove is rule-authoritative for draw guards; fullmove remains explicit for FEN round trips and replay lineage but is excluded from game-value identity.
Parse and serialize six-field Forsyth-Edwards positions with structure validation.
Maintain separate canonical serialized-position and semantic game-state records so notation metadata cannot split equivalent proof states.
Use SHA-256 over canonical serialized position and separately over semantic game state; hashes are integrity metadata, not legal identity.
Use deterministic BLAKE2b-64 as a transposition/index key while keeping SHA-256 authoritative.
Board, side, castling and effective en-passant rights form the repetition key; clocks are excluded.
Leaper offsets, pawn direction and finite slider rays provide coarse move support.
A supported destination must agree with side, own occupancy, capture and promotion semantics.
Typed pawn, knight, king and slider attacks define check and castling-transit relations.
A move commits only when the mover's king is not attacked in the resulting state.
Castling requires rights, home rook, empty corridor and unattacked origin/transit/destination.
The captured pawn is removed before testing whether the moving side's king is exposed.
A last-rank pawn event branches into exactly Q/R/B/N outcomes.
A proposed move records source hash, support, compatibility, guard status and reason codes.
Verified moves atomically patch source, destination, capture, rook motion and promotion.
Castling rights are deterministically removed by king/rook motion and home-rook capture.
Every move updates en-passant, halfmove, fullmove and side-to-move fields in a fixed order.
Committed events carry UCI, SAN, pre/post hashes, capture, promotion, check and lineage label.
Replay requires contiguous sequence and matching pre/post state hashes.
No legal moves plus check is a terminal loss for the side to move.
No legal moves without check is a draw.
Kings-only, single-minor and same-color-bishop-only exact dead positions are recognized.
Claimable 50-move/threefold and automatic 75-move/fivefold policies remain explicit.
Generate all and only moves passing support, compatibility and king-safety guards.
Count legal move paths and compare with established regression fixtures.
Generate deterministic human-readable algebraic notation downstream of legal authority.
Material and small piece-square terms order non-terminal search without becoming proof authority.
Bounded adversarial search evaluates alternating legal transitions with fail-soft mate scores.
Search depth increases monotonically and preserves the last completed result under a time budget.
At the horizon, captures, promotions and all check evasions extend tactical stability.
Cache depth, score bound and best move under a compact key; collisions cannot certify proofs.
Use TT move, promotion, capture score and UCI ordering for reproducible runs.
Encode checkmate with ply distance so faster wins and slower losses are preferred.
A forced-mate proof selects one legal attacker move with a proved child.
A proof enumerates every legal defender reply and proves every child.
A proof leaf independently verifies check, zero legal replies and declared winner.
Serialize FEN, SHA-256, node roles, chosen moves, complete replies and horizon.
A small checker regenerates legal moves, checks reply completeness and replays every edge.
Failure is reported as not forced within the declared horizon, never as a global game result.
Retrograde solve KQK and KRK over all legal three-piece cells.
Pack strong king, major piece, weak king and side into 19 exact address bits.
Invalid overlaps, adjacent kings and side-not-to-move-in-check cells are marked explicitly.
Seed checkmates as losses and stalemates as draws before retrograde propagation.
Generate exact reverse king/slider moves without storing a full edge graph.
A predecessor is win if any child is loss and loss if every child is win; unresolved cells are draw.
Wins minimize and losses maximize plies to checkmate under optimal play.
Weak-king capture of the queen/rook exits to exact K-v-K draw.
Store two bytes per dense address and gzip the payload; compression is transport, not correctness.
Color-swap plus 180-degree rotation maps black-strong KXK into the canonical white-strong table.
Select DTM-minimizing wins, DTM-maximizing losses or draw-preserving moves.
Record outcome counts, maximum DTM, byte sizes and SHA-256 transport hash.
Expose info, validate, perft, solve, prove, verify, probe, generate and demo commands.
Version proof, project and evidence records with machine-readable schemas.
A self-contained HTML page displays boards and navigates OR/AND proof branches.
Compile, run tests, check perft, proof, tablebase hashes, package schema and manifest.
Shard by typed material/history state and admit only checker-verified boundary certificates.
Name the upgrade ugts.application.chess-proof@2.0.0 rather than treating every UGTS number as one global ladder.
Represent threefold and 50-move claims as optional actions instead of forced terminal values.
Admit a draw action that declares a legal move producing the third repetition or 50-move threshold without replacing the option to execute that move.
Terminate as draw when the exact repetition identity occurs five times, after checkmate/stalemate precedence.
Terminate at 150 reversible plies, with checkmate taking precedence.
Include an en-passant target in repetition identity only when an en-passant capture is legal.
Carry exact repetition-identity occurrence counts in proof state rather than a checksum alone.
Hash the sorted exact repetition-count record for caching and proof lineage without replacing the record.
Use WIN, LOSS, DRAW and UNKNOWN; a cutoff is never coerced to DRAW.
One independently certified child LOSS is sufficient to prove the parent WIN.
Every legal action must be covered and certified WIN for the child side before the parent is LOSS.
Require no winning action plus a verified draw action, terminal or complete closed-complement argument.
Preserve open successor, history, dead-position or resource obligations as UNKNOWN.
Hash canonical state, profile, children, values and exactness into each bounded WDL node record.
Treat complete FIDE dead-position determination as a certificate obligation; the bundled detector certifies only a conservative exact subset.
Split the initial position into one stable shard per legal first move.
Aggregate only independently verified child values from the child side-to-move perspective.
Store root jobs, status, leases, candidate certificate paths and verification records in a transactional database.
Link initialization, lease, candidate and verification events with canonical SHA-256 predecessor hashes.
Lease unresolved obligations with expiry and deterministic priority/attempt order.
A candidate WDL becomes verified only after a separate checker record is hashed and attached.
Record exact depth-four path counts under each first move for scheduling evidence.
Provide a dependency-light native legality/perft/search/mate implementation independent of Python.
Propagate terminal WIN/LOSS values monotonically and classify the complete unresolved complement as DRAW only on a closed graph.
Parallelize monotone W/L candidate propagation over a closed adjacency graph.
GPU-generated move lists and value candidates cannot mutate or certify proof state without host verification.
Exchange board cells, side, rights, en-passant, counters, parent and 128-bit key fields in a fixed record.
Pack source, destination and promotion into a reversible 16-bit value.
Use versioned UGTSCB20 input and UGTSMV20 output files with fixed counts and move matrices.
Run the same packed legal generator on CPU whenever CUDA is unavailable and compare output to the Python oracle.
Compile the RTX 5070 Ti Laptop preset for CUDA architecture 120 after runtime device verification.
Allocate from measured free VRAM with a conservative fraction and fixed headroom rather than nominal capacity alone.
Overlap upload, candidate expansion and download/checking through bounded streams without reordering proof commits.
Store immutable state/certificate shards outside VRAM and merge by full content identity.
Permit short keys for lookup while requiring full state/history reconstruction and collision policy.
Accept an external endgame value only with explicit rule profile, reconstructible position and independent verification.
Require exact move-path agreement across independent rule kernels on standard stress fixtures.
Require no missing or extra CUDA/CPU packed moves against the Python legal oracle.
Record exact GPU, driver, toolkit, VRAM, latency, thermal and mismatch evidence before performance claims.
Promote the root from UNKNOWN only after all quantified WDL obligations, history semantics and checker records close.
